For a Vadodara factory, these budget combinations are worth comparing. Check the hazard-specific standard before bulk purchase; Indian industrial references commonly specify IS 2925 for helmets and relevant glove standards for mechanical/heat/electrical hazards.

Option	Approx. price	Trade-off
Udyogi Ultra 5000 LRX helmet + Udyogi UPN3 nitrile gloves	₹270 + ₹71/pair	Low cost, established PPE brand; basic general handling protection. 
Industry Buying

Karam PN521 helmet + basic nitrile gloves	₹317 + ~₹85/pair	IS 2925 helmet and better fit; gloves remain entry-level. 
Industry Buying

Mallcom Diamond XIII + D232 PU gloves	₹484 + ₹359/pair	Higher glove/helmet specification and EN certification; substantially higher cost. 
shopmallcom.in

Budget note: For cutting, chemicals, welding or electrical work, don't substitute general-purpose gloves—specify the corresponding protection class.
